title: Constructible subobjects on a Noetherian vanishing topos
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact), $f:X\to S$ a morphism of finite presentation, and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. Use the vanishing topos $V_f$ and its category of sheaves of modules over the constant ring $\Lambda$ from [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles], and finite-stratification constructibility from [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf]. Every subsheaf and every quotient sheaf of a constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $V_f$ is constructible. In an exact sequence $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ of such sheaves, if $A$ and $C$ are constructible, then $B$ is constructible. Consequently kernels, cokernels, images and finite extensions of constructible sheaves on $V_f$ are constructible.
